checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Top text exact, no full stop
must.why: Reads WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY, no period.

must.item: Bottom text exact, no full stop
must.why: Reads BUT IT'S ONLY MONDAY, no period.

must.item: Large white uppercase with black outlines, fits in image
must.why: Big white Impact-style letters with black outline, within the frame; the top line is tight to the edges but fits.

must.item: Same cat and sofa retained, eyes not covered
must.why: The cat and sofa look the same, with slight smoothing; the eyes are clear.

faults.what: The top text overlaps the tips of the ear area and sits tight to the edges. The letters are tightly spaced and slightly cramped.
The image looks slightly sharpened or re-rendered compared with the original.

summary: A clean classic meme with correct text, white letters with black outlines, a square frame, and an unobstructed shocked cat, with only minor tight spacing.
